bibl.title: Alexandria e Roma: representações, dinâmicas e vicissitudes na esfera do poder ptolomaico. [Alexandria and Rome: representations, dynamics and vicissitudes in the sphere of the Ptolemaic power.]
bibl.seg: Joana Campos Clímaco, Alexandria e Roma: representações, dinâmicas e vicissitudes na esfera do poder ptolomaico. [Alexandria and Rome: representations, dynamics and vicissitudes in the sphere of the Ptolemaic power.]
Romanitas. Revista de Estudos Grecolatinos 10 (2017) pp. 77-99.
bibl.note: Aims to evaluate how the Greco-Roman literature represents the Ptolemaic succession in order to highlight the internal "chaos" of the dynasty while justifying the need for the Roman "order" in the territory.
